issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: GPT-6 Astra
products.tagline: OpenAI's most capable model for end-to-end work
products.summaryZh: OpenAI最强大的端到端工作模型
products.descriptionZh: GPT-6 Astra是OpenAI在复杂推理、软件工程、计算机使用、科学及专业工作领域能力最强的模型。异步工具调用和回合中转向功能支持其运行多步骤智能体工作流。API：模型ID为gpt-6-astra，每100万tokens收费10美元/50美元（短上下文）。首先通过Trusted Access/Daybreak推出，随后在接下来几天内逐步覆盖Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise及API。这是OpenAI首个达到关键网络安全能力阈值（高级网络访问受限）的模型。
products.description: GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's most capable model for complex reasoning, software engineering, computer use, science, and professional work. Async tool calling and mid-turn steering help it run multistep agent workflows. API: model id gpt-6-astra, $10/$50 per 1M tokens (short context). Rolling out first via Trusted Access/Daybreak, then Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and the API in the coming days. First OpenAI model at the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold (advanced cyber access limited).

products.name: myAIcademy
products.tagline: Learn AI skills for your specific role and team
products.summaryZh: 学习适合你的角色和团队的AI技能
products.descriptionZh: myAIcademy围绕你的岗位、目标及实际使用的工具，打造个性化AI培训。通过跟练课程学习，在真实AI工具模拟环境中安全练习，并在工作中获得Aimy的分步指导。通用课程和提示词库容易过时，而myAIcademy会随AI变化持续更新内容，让你的技能同步跟上。
products.description: myAIcademy builds personalized AI training around your role, goals, and the tools you actually use. Learn through follow-along lessons, practice safely with simulations of real AI tools, and get step-by-step guidance from Aimy while you work. Generic courses and prompt libraries that quickly go stale, while myAIcademy continuously refreshes its content as AI changes, so your skills keep up too.

products.name: Compliance by TwelveLabs
products.tagline: Video compliance review powered by rules you control
products.summaryZh: 由您掌控的规则驱动的视频合规审查
products.descriptionZh: TwelveLabs的Compliance是一款SaaS应用，用于根据您团队制定的规则（而非我们的规则）审查您的视频库。它摄取视频素材，应用您自己的合规规则包，并返回带有上下文的、可供审查者直接使用的发现结果，而不仅仅是时间戳和标签。该应用由TwelveLabs的Pegasus模型驱动，能够解释某个片段为何可能违反规则，使审查者可以在一个队列中接受、拒绝或添加注释。
products.description: Compliance by TwelveLabs is a SaaS application that reviews your video library against rules your team writes, not ours. It ingests footage, applies your own compliance rule packs, and returns reviewer-ready findings with context, not just a timestamp and a label. Powered by TwelveLabs' Pegasus model, it explains why a moment may violate a rule so reviewers can accept, reject, or annotate in one queue.

products.name: Google Gemini 3.8 Flash and Cyber
products.tagline: Next-gen Gemini for agents, reasoning, and cyber security
products.summaryZh: 面向智能体、推理与网络安全的下一代Gemini
products.descriptionZh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 与 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber 为智能体工作流和网络安全带来下一代智能。它们专为长周期编码、多步推理、自主任务和漏洞检测而构建，以 Flash 速度和低成本提供更强大的性能。
products.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber bring next-generation intelligence to agentic workflows and cybersecurity. Built for long-horizon coding, multi-step reasoning, autonomous tasks, and vulnerability detection, they deliver stronger performance at Flash speed and low cost.

products.name: cmmnts
products.tagline: Add a powerful comment section to any website
products.summaryZh: 为任何网站添加一个功能强大的评论区
products.descriptionZh: 为网站添加评论功能，无需从零搭建评论系统。cmmnts提供讨论所需的一切——线程、审核、登录、匿名评论、Markdown、提及、表情符号和GIF。将其嵌入网站，即可开始收集评论。
products.description: Adding comments to your website shouldn’t require building a comment system from scratch. cmmnts gives you everything you need for discussions—threads, moderation, login, anonymous comments, Markdown, mentions, emoji, and GIFs. Drop it into your site and start collecting comments.

products.name: Omarchy
products.tagline: The malleable OS for the age of agents
products.summaryZh: 面向智能体时代的可塑操作系统
products.descriptionZh: Omarchy是一款基于Arch、Hyprland和Quickshell的omakase风格Linux桌面。它提供了一套完整的键盘优先工作站，包含系统级主题、打包更新，以及能够重塑配置的编码代理，无需自行组装。
products.description: Omarchy is an omakase Linux desktop on Arch, Hyprland, and Quickshell. It ships a complete keyboard-first workstation with system-wide themes, packaged updates, and coding agents that can reshape the setup instead of making you assemble it yourself.

products.name: WeatherNext 3
products.tagline: Our most advanced and accurate global weather AI model
products.summaryZh: 我们最先进、最精准的全球天气AI模型
products.descriptionZh: 我们的旗舰AI天气预报模型现已纳入实时卫星数据、每小时更新、更高分辨率、精准降水预报及清洁能源变量。该模型现已整合至搜索、Gemini、地图、Google Maps平台及云端服务中。
products.description: Our flagship AI weather forecasting model now includes real-time satellite data, hourly refreshes, higher resolution, precise precipitation forecasting, and clean energy variables. It’s now integrated across Search, Gemini, Maps, Google Maps Platform, and Cloud.

products.name: Snitch
products.tagline: Your Slack org chart, built by everyone in it.
products.summaryZh: 你的Slack组织架构图，由其中每个人共同构建。
products.descriptionZh: Snitch向Slack中的每个人提出一个问题：你向谁汇报？并根据回答构建组织架构图。随后，它能回答相关问题：汇报链、团队规模、职责归属。无需人力资源系统，无需您填写任何内容。
products.description: Snitch asks everyone in your Slack one question, who do you report to, and builds the org chart from the answers. Then it answers questions about it: reporting chains, team sizes, who owns what. No HR system, nothing for you to fill in.

products.name: TrackMCP
products.tagline: Google Analytics for MCP Servers
products.summaryZh: Google Analytics 的 MCP 服务器
products.descriptionZh: TrackMCP展示谁在使用你的MCP服务器、他们试图做什么、工作是否完成以及何处改进。这一切只需一行代码。
products.description: TrackMCP shows who is using your MCP server, what they are trying to do, whether the work gets done, and where to improve. All from one line of code.

products.name: sidebranch
products.tagline: Easy git-based visual diffing
products.summaryZh: 基于Git的简易可视化差异比较
products.descriptionZh: 在运行中的应用内审阅PR：通过页面内组件切换分支，并排比较工作树。仅限回环，零依赖。
products.description: Review PRs from inside your running app: switch branches from an in-page widget and compare worktrees side by side. Loopback-only, zero dependencies.

products.name: Inline
products.tagline: Multiplayer work with AI, teammates, and friends
products.summaryZh: 与AI、队友和朋友一起多人游戏。
products.descriptionZh: Inline是一款基于话题线程的聊天应用，适用于所有工作场景，可与你的团队及智能代理协作。
products.description: Inline is a thread-based chat app for all work, with your team and agents.

products.name: Offline JS Playground
products.tagline: Write, run, and test JavaScript snippets & JSON offline
products.summaryZh: 离线编写、运行和测试JavaScript代码片段与JSON。
products.descriptionZh: 一个简单的游乐场，用于编写、运行和测试JavaScript代码片段，并带有界面内控制台。专为快速实验、调试、学习、测试想法以及无需完整开发环境即可处理JavaScript而设计。该工具默认离线运行，在Chrome中直接提供一个强大的JavaScript游乐场。
products.description: A simple playground to write, run, and test JavaScript snippets, with an in-UI console. Built for quick experiments, debugging, learning, testing ideas, and working with JavaScript without needing a full development environment. This tool is offline by design, providing a robust JavaScript playground directly within Chrome.

products.name: Clockwork
products.tagline: The calendar where your AI agents show up for work
products.summaryZh: 你的AI代理们在此打卡上班的日历。
products.descriptionZh: 在真实日历上预定AI编程代理。Clockwork在Mac的沙盒git工作树中无人值守运行它们，遇到风险操作时暂停等待批准，并提交包含实际美元成本的报告。自带密钥或使用现有订阅。在真实日历上安排周期性代理任务，在隔离沙盒中无人值守运行，并审阅如实报告。
products.description: Book AI coding agents on a real calendar. Clockwork runs them unattended in sandboxed git worktrees on your Mac, pauses for approval when something looks risky, and files a report with the actual dollar cost. Bring your own key or ride your existing subscription. Schedule recurring agent jobs on a real calendar, run them unattended in isolated sandboxes, and review honest reports.

products.name: Chalked for Mac
products.tagline: Your replies ready with your work's full context
products.summaryZh: 您的回复已准备好，包含工作的完整背景。
products.descriptionZh: Chalked是Mac上的回复层。打开支持的对话，它会根据可见线程、实时日历和来源工作上下文，准备你实际会说的话。按Tab键插入，按住fn键通过语音更改预期结果，然后审阅并自行发送。被接受或编辑的沟通内容可成为可检查的证据，使后续回复更智能。语音为可选功能。不会自动发送任何内容。
products.description: Chalked is the reply layer for Mac. Open a supported conversation and it prepares what you would actually say from the visible thread, live calendar and sourced working context. Press Tab to insert, hold fn to change the intended outcome by voice, then review and send yourself. Accepted or edited communication can become inspectable evidence, so later replies start smarter. Voice is optional. Nothing auto-sends.

products.name: A2A Net
products.tagline: Automatically optimize an AI agent from your B2B SaaS APIs
products.summaryZh: 自动优化来自B2B SaaS API的AI代理
products.descriptionZh: A2A Net是一个面向B2B SaaS的平台，可自动从其API优化AI代理，客户可在其网站、应用、Slack、Teams、Copilot和Gemini Enterprise中使用该代理！该代理优化器基于GEPA，并专门针对对话式代理进行了调整。每个代理都配备代码模式、文件上传和下载以及其他优秀功能。如果您有OpenAPI规范或MCP服务器，可在5分钟内从您的URL为您的B2B SaaS创建代理！
products.description: A2A Net is the platform for B2B SaaS to automatically optimize an AI agent from their APIs that their customers can use in their website, app, Slack, Teams, Copilot, and Gemini Enterprise! The agent optimizer is based on GEPA and has been adapted specifically for conversational agents. Every agent comes with code mode, file upload and download, and other great features. If you have an OpenAPI spec or an MCP server, you can create an agent for your B2B SaaS in 5 minutes from your URL!

products.name: Trends
products.tagline: See what's driving the most popular topics on podcasts
products.summaryZh: 看看哪些话题正在播客中引发热议。
products.descriptionZh: 本周早些时候，我们推出了播客搜索引擎Radar。Radar可搜索超过13万个播客，涵盖数百万小时、数十亿行内容，全部可检索。现在，我们在Radar中推出了新功能：趋势。趋势包括电视节目、电影、电子游戏、嘉宾出场等分类排行榜。精确查看变化内容、变化时间及原因。添加“突发”过滤器，轻松识别最新热门话题。您还可以为趋势列表中的实体创建提醒。
products.description: Earlier this week, we launched Radar, the podcast search engine. Radar searches 130,000+ podcasts. Millions of hours and billions of lines, fully searchable. Now we're launching a new feature within Radar: trends. Trends includes category charts for TV shows, movies, video games, guest appearances, and more. See exactly what changed, when it changed, and why. Add a 'breaking' filter to easily spot the newest trending topics. You can also create alerts for entities included in trending lists.

products.name: Email Health Check by Truelist
products.tagline: Grade your email list's health in 30 seconds, free
products.summaryZh: 30秒免费评估你的邮件列表健康度
products.descriptionZh: 上传任意CSV文件，即可获得实时健康报告：包含总体评级及正常/风险/待定/无效分类明细，并实时对照真实邮件服务器进行校验。免费使用，无需注册，报告无需邮箱验证。基于Truelist引擎运行——已校验超过10亿封邮件。
products.description: Upload any CSV and get a real-time health report: an overall grade plus the Ok / Risky / Catch-all / Invalid breakdown, checked live against actual mail servers. Free, no signup, no email-gated report. Runs on the Truelist engine — 1B+ emails validated.

products.name: SCRUB.
products.tagline: Run creator campaigns across platforms, end to end
products.summaryZh: 跨平台端到端运营创作者营销活动
products.descriptionZh: Scrub将品牌、创作者和创作者技术整合于一个平台。品牌可以发现并开展与任何规模创作者的营销活动——从50名粉丝到50万以上。创作者无论受众规模大小，都能发现品牌机会并为其内容获得报酬。从发现和活动管理到自动化、追踪和集成，Scrub将整个创作者营销工作流程汇聚于一处。
products.description: Scrub brings brands, creators, and creator tech together in one platform. Brands can discover and run campaigns with creators of any size — from 50 followers to 500K+. Creators can discover brand opportunities and get paid for their content, regardless of audience size. From discovery and campaign management to automation, tracking, and integrations, Scrub brings the entire creator marketing workflow into one place.

products.name: Grid Maker for Drawing
products.tagline: Turn reference photos into printable drawing grids
products.summaryZh: 将参考照片转换为可打印的绘图网格
products.descriptionZh: Grid Maker for Drawing是一款免费的浏览器工具，面向使用网格法的艺术家、学生和教师。上传参考图片，添加带标签的可调网格，并规划到纸张、画布或墙面的缩放。无需创建账户即可下载PNG或打印网格。图像处理在您的浏览器中完成。
products.description: Grid Maker for Drawing is a free browser-based tool for artists, students, and teachers who use the grid method. Upload a reference image, add an adjustable grid with labels, and plan scaling to paper, canvas, or a wall. Download a PNG or print the grid without creating an account. Image processing happens in your browser.

products.name: Trailmarks iOS
products.tagline: Real World Travel Quiz & Trivia Adventure
products.summaryZh: 真实世界旅行问答与 trivia 冒险
products.descriptionZh: Trailmarks是一款基于真实世界的旅行问答游戏。你回答所在城市的真假题，然后用奖励购买离城车票，受出发时刻表及你的支付能力限制。你的得分是身后的公里数。路线真实：存在的航班、有轨道的火车、跨洋的船只。覆盖1000多个城市。仅限iPhone，一次性付费4.99美元，无广告，无需账户，完全离线可玩。
products.description: Trailmarks is a travel trivia game built on the real world. You answer true-or-false questions about the city you're in, then spend the rewards on a ticket out, limited by what the departure board offers and what you can afford. Your score is the kilometers behind you. The routes are real: flights that exist, trains where there are tracks, boats across oceans. 1000+ cities. iPhone only, $4.99 once, no ads, no account, plays fully offline.
